grammatical_complexity.notes: Past simple dominates, but past perfect appears 5+ times and participial clauses appear 3+ times as a noticeable minority. First conditional and reported speech also present. Solid level 3 profile.

references_found: Latin American fruits (lulo, níspero, guanabana, etc. - familiar to learner)
cultural_reference_load.notes: Most of the setting is Latin American, which the learner would recognize well. US-specific references (Whole Foods, Upper East Side, customs procedures) are light and understandable from context. The plot is fully followable without knowing these details.

sentence_structure.notes: Mixed lengths. Some very long sentences with multiple subordinate clauses (e.g., the opening paragraph sentence at 40+ words), but many short simple sentences throughout. Average around 15-20 words.

items.context: a large Latin American living room
items.reason: Spanish speaker might think 'largo' (long), but in the context of a living room, 'big' is the obvious meaning. Minimal confusion risk.

items.reason: Spanish speaker might think 'ropa' (clothing). 'Tied up tight by clothing' is odd enough to cause a moment of confusion, though context eventually disambiguates.
